title: Understanding PC $$2$$
text: Principal Component $$2$$ (PC 2) is orthogonal to Principal Component $$1$$ (PC 1). This means that the line representing PC $$2$$ should be perpendicular to the line representing PC $$1$$.

title: Slope of Perpendicular Lines
text: If two lines are perpendicular, the product of their slopes is $$-1$$. If the slope of PC $$1$$ is $$m$$, then the slope of PC $$2$$ should be $$\frac{-1}{m}$$.

title: Calculate the Slope of PC $$2$$
text: Given that the slope of PC $$1$$ is $$\frac{2}{3}$$, what is the slope of PC 2?

title: Equation of PC $$2$$
text: The equation of a line can be written in the form $$y=mx$$, where $$m$$ is the slope. Use the slope you calculated for PC $$2$$ to find its equation.
